### Main questions

We set out to understand the role of ERAP2 in ALS. The main questions that have been defined until now are,

- What is the effect of ERAP2 siRNA in control lines?
- What is the effect between control and ALS lines? 
- What is the effect of ERAP2 siRNA on ALS lines?

### Gene set enrichment analysis

- Perform gene set enrichment

```{r}

require("enrichR")
protein_split <- split(differentially_expressed_events_df, differentially_expressed_events_df$contrast)

dbs <- "GO_Biological_Process_2023"
groups <- names(protein_split)
directions <- c("up", "down")
kd_geneset_enrichment_df <- do.call(rbind, lapply(groups, function(a_group){
    a_temp_df <- protein_split[[a_group]]
    return_df <- do.call(rbind, lapply(directions, function(a_direction){
            db_df_list <- lapply(dbs, function(a_database){
                message(paste(a_database, a_direction, a_group))
                current_fcs <- a_temp_df$log2FoldChange[a_temp_df$direction == a_direction]
                current_genes <- a_temp_df$gene_name[a_temp_df$direction == a_direction]
                an_enrichment_df <- enrichr(current_genes,  a_database)[[1]]
                if(nrow(an_enrichment_df) == 0){
                    return(NULL)
                }
                an_enrichment_df$direction <- a_direction
                an_enrichment_df$num_gene <- length(current_genes)
                an_enrichment_df$db <- a_database
                Sys.sleep(5)
                return(an_enrichment_df)
            })
            db_df <- do.call(rbind, db_df_list)
        }))
    return_df$contrasts <- a_group
    return(return_df)
}))


kd_geneset_enrichment_df$gene_ratio <- vapply(kd_geneset_enrichment_df$Overlap, function(x){
    eval(parse(text = x))
},1)

annotated_proteomic_gene_set_enrichment_df <- read.csv(file.path("14-erap2-kd-proteomics/output_files/03-annotated-gene-set-enrichment-with-go-bp.csv"))

significant_gene_set_enrichment <- kd_geneset_enrichment_df[kd_geneset_enrichment_df$P.value < 0.05 & kd_geneset_enrichment_df$gene_ratio > 0.1,]
significant_gene_set_enrichment$Group <- annotated_proteomic_gene_set_enrichment_df[match(significant_gene_set_enrichment$Term, annotated_proteomic_gene_set_enrichment_df$Term),"Group"]
significant_gene_set_enrichment$ids <- vapply(str_extract_all(string = significant_gene_set_enrichment$Term, pattern = "(?<=\\()(.*?)(?=\\))"), function(x){x[length(x)]},"1")
write.csv(significant_gene_set_enrichment, file = file.path(output_dir, "03-gene-set-enrichment-with-go-bp.csv"))
# Perform enrichment smplify


```

- Read annotated gene set enrichment table

```{r}

require("ggplot2")
require("ggbeeswarm")


return_plots_for_top_terms <- function(temp_df, top = 10){

    upregulated_terms_df <- temp_df[temp_df$direction == "up",]

    my_theme <- theme(
        legend.position = "bottom",
        text = element_text(size = 12),
        axis.text.x = element_text(size = 12),
        axis.text.y = element_text(size = 12),
        legend.text = element_text(size = 10),
        legend.title = element_text(size = 10),
        plot.background = element_blank(),
        panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
        panel.grid.major = element_line(colour = "azure3",
        linetype = "dashed",
        size = 0.2))

    median_gene_ratio <- vapply(split(upregulated_terms_df$gene_ratio, upregulated_terms_df$Group), length, 1)
    upregulated_terms_df$Group <- factor(upregulated_terms_df$Group, 
        levels = names(median_gene_ratio[order(median_gene_ratio, decreasing = F)]))
    keep_levels <- levels(upregulated_terms_df$Group)
    keep_levels <- keep_levels[keep_levels != "Other Processes"]

    ThePlot_1 <- ggplot(upregulated_terms_df[upregulated_terms_df$Group %in% rev(keep_levels)[1:top],], aes(x = -log10(P.value), y = Group))
    # ThePlot <- ThePlot + geom_boxplot(aes(fill = direction), colour = "#000000", 
    #     width = 0.5, lwd = 0.5)
    ThePlot_1 <- ThePlot_1 + geom_quasirandom(aes(fill = direction), colour = "#000000", shape = 21)
    # ThePlot <- ThePlot + geom_hline(aes(yintercept = 1), colour = "#000000", lty = "dashed")
    ThePlot_1 <- ThePlot_1 + scale_x_continuous("-log10 pvalue")
    ThePlot_1 <- ThePlot_1 + scale_y_discrete("Upregulated terms from GO:BP")
    ThePlot_1 <- ThePlot_1 + scale_fill_manual("direction", values = c("up" = "#E0777D", "down" = "#4C86A8"))
    ThePlot_1 <- ThePlot_1 + theme_bw()
    ThePlot_1 <- ThePlot_1 + ggtitle("Upregulated genes")
    ThePlot_1 <- ThePlot_1 + my_theme


    downregulated_terms_df <- temp_df[temp_df$direction == "down",]
    median_gene_ratio <- vapply(split(downregulated_terms_df$gene_ratio, downregulated_terms_df$Group), length, 1)
    downregulated_terms_df$Group <- factor(downregulated_terms_df$Group, 
        levels = names(median_gene_ratio[order(median_gene_ratio, decreasing = F)]))
    keep_levels <- levels(downregulated_terms_df$Group)
    keep_levels <- keep_levels[keep_levels != "Other Processes"]

    ThePlot_2 <- ggplot(downregulated_terms_df[downregulated_terms_df$Group %in% rev(keep_levels)[1:top],], aes(x = -log10(P.value), y = Group))
    # ThePlot <- ThePlot + geom_boxplot(aes(fill = direction), colour = "#000000", 
    #     width = 0.5, lwd = 0.5)
    ThePlot_2 <- ThePlot_2 + geom_quasirandom(aes(fill = direction), colour = "#000000", shape = 21)
    # ThePlot <- ThePlot + geom_hline(aes(yintercept = 1), colour = "#000000", lty = "dashed")
    ThePlot_2 <- ThePlot_2 + scale_x_continuous("-log10 pvalue")
    ThePlot_2 <- ThePlot_2 + scale_y_discrete("Downregulated terms from GO:BP")
    ThePlot_2 <- ThePlot_2 + scale_fill_manual("direction", values = c("up" = "#E0777D", "down" = "#4C86A8"))
    ThePlot_2 <- ThePlot_2 + theme_bw()
    ThePlot_2 <- ThePlot_2 + ggtitle("Downregulated genes")
    ThePlot_2 <- ThePlot_2 + my_theme

    require("patchwork")
    ThePlot <- ThePlot_1 | ThePlot_2
    return(ThePlot)
}

annotated_gene_set_enrichment_df <- read.csv(file.path(output_dir, "03-annotated-gene-set-enrichment-with-go-bp.csv"))

als_vs_control_df <- annotated_gene_set_enrichment_df[annotated_gene_set_enrichment_df$contrasts == "als_vs_ctrl",]
als_vs_control_plot <- return_plots_for_top_terms(als_vs_control_df)

ggsave(width = 10, height = 12, file = file.path(plot_dir, "02-01-plot-als-vs-control-gene-set-enrichment-using-gobp.pdf"), als_vs_control_plot)

```
